categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/spend.cpp` along with wallet spend tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a potential null-pointer dereference in `AvailableCoins()` when handling unconfirmed mempool outputs under TRUC filtering. Although dereferencing `nullptr` causes a crash, the author notes that no current production callers trigger this path because 'RPCs, the GUI and CreateTransaction always pass a coin control', making this a latent correctness bug rather than an active crash vulnerability.
